messages:
priya: Quick heads-up  we need clear SI handoff rules for deals that touch marketplace SKUs + HW partners. Last week there were 3 cross-posted leads. Not good.

dan: Agree. can we add a simple certification-level rule? e.g., Gold-certified HW -> auto-handoff to SI; Bronze -> review.

leo: Also add a "deal complexity" score: integrations > 3 systems or private deployment => SI review. Helps PS staffing.

sam: Two practical asks: 1) SLA for handoff (how long before AE must share materials?) 2) where to log rebate ownership for HW partners?

priya: Proposal: handoff SLA = 48h after opp enters "SI-intake" stage. AE must upload: deal brief, Commerce SKU list, customer contacts, expected go-live. Rebate owner field lives in the intake form (commerce_owner).

emma: For clarity, I'm adding a small mapping that the intake will enforce. Example YAML we can paste into Confluence:

```yaml
# simplified owner mapping for intake
- condition: certified_hw == true
  owner: SI
  notes: "Gold or Platinum certified hardware bundles -> SI primary"
- condition: marketplace_sku in ['marketplace-dedicated', 'rdw-enterprise-sku']
  owner: SI if override_optin == true
  notes: "marketplace SKUs default to AE unless Partnerships opt-in for co-sell"
- condition: deal_complexity_score >= 7 or private_deploy == true
  owner: SI
- condition: referral_credit > 0 and ARR < 250000
  owner: AE
  notes: "referrals without HW default to AE unless ARR threshold met"
```

dan: Love the YAML. Two tweaks: add 'engineering_presales_required' boolean and 'rebate_owner' enum per partner.

leo: Edge-case: multi-SI deals where two partners want ownership. Suggest rule: earliest registered partner at intake wins; require partner confirmation within 24h or it falls back to AE.

priya: Good call. Add a timestamped registration field and an auto-fallback. Also add an approvals step: Partnerships + Sales Ops must approve any override. Keep approval thread in Slack for audit.

sam: Can we auto-generate a Slack alert to #partners-ops when a high-complexity opp is flagged? Means we can triage fast.

partners-bot: Tip: you can set a workflow in Workflows to post on label changes. See /workflows list.

emma: I'll include the Slack alert rule in the intake PR: if deal_complexity_score >= 7 or includes_private_deploy -> post to #partners-ops with opp link and assignees.

dan: About HW rebates: Kelly in Finance said rebates map to partner contract owner. We'll add a 'rebate_owner' field with values: Partner, Redwood, Shared. Finance will populate after contract signature.

leo: Implementation notes for intake form: require checkboxes for certified_hw, private_deploy, referral_credit (USD), engineering_presales_required, marketplace_optin. Make referral_credit numeric.

priya: Action items: 1) Emma: PR to intake + YAML mapping + Slack alert by Tue noon. 2) Dan: add rebate_owner enum and Finance contact. 3) Leo: write multi-SI tie-breaker rule & registration timestamp logic. 4) Priya: run a 15m triage on Wed to confirm wording.

emma: I'll draft the PR and include a sample CSV export for Commerce SKUs to validate matching.

dan: Small governance ask: for the first 30 days make marketplace_optin manual (Partnerships must opt-in). We can relax later with telemetry.

leo: I'll add telemetry flags: number of opt-ins, lead conflicts, SLA misses. Dashboard TBD in Console.

priya: One more: co-announcement timing. SI asks for 10 business days prep for co-branded assets. Propose standard 10bd notice and a checklist: legal review, marketing assets, SI logo cert, customer PR approval.

sam: Sounds sensible. Add that to the intake as "announce_timing_days" default 10 and checkbox for "co-branded".

emma: PR plan accepted. tagging @priya @dan @leo. I'll include sample messages for marketing and a tiny template for customer approvals.

partners-bot: New page created: https://rwd.atlassian.net/space/PS/pages/si-handoff-matrix (intake PR link to follow). :page_with_curl:

priya: Recap in 1 line for doc: Emma (intake + slack alert + PR), Dan (rebate_owner + Finance link), Leo (tie-breaker + telemetry), Sam (SLA + announcement timing), Priya (triage + final signoff).

leo: No objections. Let's ship conservative defaults and iterate.

priya: Thanks team 64f. Expect PR link in ~6h.
